docker-deployment-en.heading: Container Deployment > Compose Deployment
docker-deployment-en.snippet: # Container Deployment ## Compose Deployment Build the Docker image, configure environment variables, mount persistent volumes, and start the container with Docker Compose. The deployment health check must pass before traffic reaches the service.

english-query-slovak-storage.heading: TrueNAS Operations > Obnova po zlyhaní disku
english-query-slovak-storage.snippet: # TrueNAS Operations ## Obnova po zlyhaní disku Po zlyhaní disku obnovte dáta zo sieťového úložiska do náhradného zariadenia. Vyberte overenú snímku, skontrolujte oprávnenia obnovených súborov a až potom sprístupnite úložisko používateľom.

english-query-slovak-storage.heading: TrueNAS > Scope
english-query-slovak-storage.snippet: # TrueNAS ## Scope This operational reference covers ownership, maintenance windows, validation records, escalation contacts, and readiness checks for a managed storage appliance.

fastapi-auth-en.heading: FastAPI Service > Bearer Authentication
fastapi-auth-en.snippet: # FastAPI Service ## Bearer Authentication The FastAPI dependency reads the Authorization header, validates the Bearer token, and rejects an invalid API key before request-body processing. Overenie tokenu prebieha pred volaním endpointu.

hierarchy-database-recovery.heading: PostgreSQL > Recovery Procedure
hierarchy-database-recovery.snippet: ## Recovery Procedure Retain three protected generations, restore the selected generation into an isolated target, verify every recovered item, and record the recovery result before reopening the service.

oracle-apex-rest-en.heading: Oracle APEX Integration > REST APIs
oracle-apex-rest-en.snippet: # Oracle APEX Integration ## REST APIs Oracle APEX publishes REST endpoints through ORDS. The API accepts JSON, invokes PL/SQL, checks authentication, and returns database results without exposing internal connection credentials.

postgres-replication-en.heading: PostgreSQL Operations > Streaming Replication
postgres-replication-en.snippet: ## Streaming Replication Streaming replication sends WAL records from the primary PostgreSQL server to a standby replica. Monitor replication lag, slots, failover readiness, and the replay position before promoting the standby.

truenas-storage-en.heading: TrueNAS Operations > Storage Pools
truenas-storage-en.snippet: ## Storage Pools TrueNAS storage uses mirrored disks, ZFS pools, datasets, quotas, and scheduled scrubs. NAS úložisko separates application data from media and keeps enough free pool capacity for snapshots.
